messages:
sanjay: heads up, eu canary showing spike in 5xxs and some crashloops. pausing rollout :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Release 2026.3.4: canary -> PAUSED by sanjay at 2026-03-20T10:02Z
amanda: copy. what are we seeing, service or infra?
maria: OOMKills on model-inference pods, looks like kvcache growth, repeated OOMKill in pod logs
ops-oncall: confirmed node-level oom events on 3 hosts eu-west1
sanjay: root cause likely kvcache retention bump from yesterday + longer seq lengths in canary traffic
dzhao: can we avoid full rollback? maybe force kvcache eviction or lower cache size flag
release-manager: action items: pause deploy, pin canary tag for safe rollback, notify CS/support if customer impact, pick new window
amanda: pinning fallback tag now
amanda: /pin-release 2026.3.4-canary -> 2026.2.9-stable
deploy-bot: Command acknowledged. Version pin applied. Canary saved: 2026.3.4-canary -> fallback 2026.2.9-stable
maria: quick trial: restart kvcache sidecar reduced memory ~40% on one pod. could be rolling mitigation if safe
ops-oncall: prefer rollback; live tweaks risky during canary, recommend rollback to 2026.2.9 for canary traffic
sanjay: agree. rollback canary only, keep rollout paused globally
amanda: initiating canary rollback, ETA ~4m
deploy-bot: Rolling back canary to 2026.2.9-stable. Progress: 2/5 pods rolled back
maria: metrics update: error rate down on pods 1/2
dzhao: creating hotfix branch to revert retention bump and add eviction + smoke test
release-manager: original window 16:00-18:00 UTC. propose move to tomorrow 12:00-14:00 UTC to allow fix + QA
ops-oncall: ok with new window, avoids EU peak
sanjay: please log root cause in release notes and create postmortem ticket
amanda: notes: "Canary paused due to kvcache memory regression causing OOMs; rolled back to 2026.2.9. Hotfix in progress." will add to release board
maria: add memory smoke test to canary harness
dzhao: adding memory smoke + kvcache eviction unit test in PR
deploy-bot: Release 2026.3.4: canary -> ROLLED BACK to 2026.2.9 by amanda at 2026-03-20T10:11Z
release-manager: reschedule confirmed. New change window: 2026-03-21T12:00Z-14:00Z UTC. Stakeholders notified
amanda: pinging @support @cs to hold customer-facing comms until hotfix validated
ops-oncall: monitoring node oom trends for 24h
sanjay: postmortem INF-4123 created. RCA meeting scheduled 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC. assign owners
maria: attaching logs and heap profile to INF-4123
dzhao: PR target ready in ~3h, aiming for canary redeploy in rescheduled window
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-21T11:30Z - preflight checks
amanda: moving follow-ups to INF-4123 and PR thread
ops-oncall: ack
sanjay: ack
maria: ack
dzhao: ack
